description: Hand one task to a fresh helper from an agent definition you choose and get back only its short conclusion; its tool calls stay out of your history. The helper knows only goal and context, keeps the definition's tools unless tools is given, and uses your brain unless endpoint says otherwise. If your brain settings cannot be read, the call fails: give endpoint to choose one. It is removed when done unless keep is true. Depth travels as the AOS_THOUGHT_DEPTH launch parameter; helpers may start helpers only one level deeper. Example: {"from": "helpers/reviewer", "goal": "Review the result and return one sentence"}. Details: memory node agents/thought.

from.description: required agent definition folder, relative to your workspace or absolute; it must declare aos-agent in interfaces.json

goal.description: what to do and what to bring back, one to a few sentences

context.description: background the helper needs, e.g. conclusions of earlier steps; a string or an array of strings

tools.description: tools for the helper; omit to keep the definition's tools, or give [] to remove all tools

path.description: tool folder, relative to your workspace or absolute; leave it out to lend the helper your own tool of that name

endpoint.description: the helper's brain pack (e.g. stupid-fast to save money); default: the same as yours

max_chars.description: at most this many characters come back; default 600 (longer ones end with [truncated])

timeout_s.description: finite positive seconds to wait for the conclusion; default 600, no fixed upper limit

keep.description: true keeps the helper (stopped) and adds a last line details: <its stack>/ for later inspection; default false
